automaticPhaseSkips.title: Automatic phase skips
automaticPhaseSkips.body: Phase skips are automatic. Use stops or Full Control when you want paper-style priority windows.

phaseStops.title: Phase stops
phaseStops.body: A stop pauses before that step, similar to saying you may act before combat, before draw, or before the end step in paper.

fullControl.title: Full Control
fullControl.body: Full Control keeps priority windows from being skipped, including spots where the digital client would normally keep the game moving.

resolve.title: Resolve
resolve.body: Resolve means you pass priority so the top spell or ability on the stack can resolve if everyone else also passes.

passToEnd.title: Pass to End
passToEnd.body: Pass to End keeps passing priority for the turn unless a choice, stop, or Full Control interrupts.

manaPayment.title: Mana payment
manaPayment.body: During mana payment, you can tap lands manually or press T to tap available lands.

combatDeclarations.title: Combat declarations
combatDeclarations.body: The game asks for attackers and blockers only during the declaration steps. Choose creatures, then confirm the declaration.

passPriority.title: Pass priority
passPriority.body: Pass priority or advance through the current priority prompt.

undo.title: Undo
undo.body: Undo the last local action that did not reveal hidden information.

cancel.title: Cancel
cancel.body: Cancel the current selection, mana payment, target selection, or auto-pass when available.

advancedDebugPanel.title: Advanced debug panel
advancedDebugPanel.body: Open the advanced debug panel. Most players should start with Recovery Tools first.

reportOrExportState.title: Report or export state
reportOrExportState.body: If a card misbehaves, export the current game state so the exact board position can be reproduced.

boardRightClickMenu.title: Board right-click menu
boardRightClickMenu.body: On desktop, right-click empty board space for the game log, recovery/debug tools, and background settings.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.intro: Test PeerJS signaling and TURN using two temporary connections and tiny test messages. Checks take up to 35 seconds and leave your match unchanged.
troubleshooting.privacy: The JSON report contains technical observations only. It excludes game contents, player IDs, room codes, credentials and console logs. Recent history stays in this tab for up to one hour, including across reloads.
troubleshooting.history: Recent events: {{count}}. Past events do not prove a current outage.
troubleshooting.failed: The report could not be saved. Try again.
troubleshooting.runnerFailed: Checks could not finish. Try again.

reasons.online: The browser reports online. This does not confirm internet access.
reasons.offline: The browser reports offline. Check your network connection.
reasons.hidden: Return to this tab; background tabs may be slowed down.
reasons.unsupported: WebAssembly or WebRTC is unavailable. Some checks cannot run in this browser.
reasons.noEngine: No local engine instance is registered. Engine health was not checked.
reasons.engineReady: A local engine instance answered. It may not be the engine running your match.
reasons.engineWaiting: A local engine instance is not ready. Wait, then run checks again.
reasons.probeFailed: The probe failed. If this repeats, save the report before leaving.
reasons.probeTimeout: The engine did not answer in time. Wait, then try again; save the report if this repeats.
reasons.noPeer: No live peer is registered. Peer health was not checked.
reasons.peerConnected: The player connection is open. Any queued work is recorded in the report.
reasons.peerWaiting: The player connection is still connecting or is disconnected. Wait and check again.
reasons.peerDisconnectedDuringCheck: The player connection disconnected during these checks. Save this report before trying again.
reasons.relayConnectionFailed: The relay connection failed during setup or transfer. The error category below identifies the failure reported by PeerJS.
reasons.peerFailed: The transport reported an error. Save this report if the problem repeats.
reasons.relayed: This connection uses a relay. Relay usage is normal and is not a failure.
reasons.statsUnavailable: Connection route details are unavailable. This is not evidence of a failure.
reasons.directoryReached: The directory returned a successful HTTP response. This checks reachability only, not gameplay health.
reasons.directoryFailed: The directory check did not succeed. Check your connection and try again.
reasons.modeNotChecked: WebSocket and native gameplay engine health are not checked here, even if local engine instances appear.
reasons.direct: The observed connection is direct and does not use a relay.
reasons.draftModeNotChecked: These checks do not verify the engine running a draft match; it may be local or remote.
reasons.networkUnsupported: This browser cannot run the PeerJS relay test. Try an up-to-date browser with WebRTC support.
reasons.credentialsReady: Fresh TURN credentials were retrieved. Relay access is checked separately below.
reasons.credentialsFailed: Fresh TURN credentials could not be retrieved or contained no usable relay. Retry; if this continues, download the report for support. A VPN, filter, or service outage may be involved.
reasons.credentialsTimeout: The TURN credential service did not answer in time. Check your network, retry, and download the report if this continues.
reasons.prerequisiteFailed: The relay test could not run because credentials or signaling failed. This does not establish a TURN transport failure.
reasons.signalingReady: Both temporary peers registered with PeerJS. The relay check also exercises offer and answer forwarding.
reasons.signalingFailed: PeerJS signaling failed. A network filter, VPN, or signaling service problem may be involved. Try another network and download the report if this repeats.
reasons.signalingTimeout: PeerJS did not register both temporary peers in time. Check network or VPN restrictions, try another network, and save the report if this repeats.
reasons.relayReady: The expected message returned through selected relay candidates. This browser can use TURN now.
reasons.relayEvidenceUnavailable: A relay result could not be verified from selected candidate statistics. Download the report; this is not proof that TURN is down.
reasons.relayNoCandidates: No relay candidates were observed before the test failed or timed out. TURN access may be blocked or unavailable. Try another network and share the report with support.
reasons.relayNoEcho: Relay candidates were observed, but the expected message did not return. Try another network, then download the report if this repeats.

troubleshooting.pastEngine: A local engine was not ready earlier. If this repeats, save the report before leaving.
troubleshooting.pastDisconnect: An unexpected player disconnect was recorded earlier. If this repeats, save the report before leaving.
troubleshooting.limitations: This same-device test checks this browser’s relay path now. It cannot verify another player, lasting match reliability, or every UDP/TCP transport separately.
troubleshooting.pastSetup: A player connection setup problem was recorded earlier. See the report for its stage; this does not establish a current outage.
troubleshooting.routeEvidence: Selected candidates: local {{local}}, remote {{remote}}. Candidate protocol: {{protocol}} (not the client-to-TURN transport).
